```{r}
library(reticulate)
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(progress)

# Import SAHI slicing function
sahi <- import("sahi.slicing")

# Function to slice images in a directory
slice_images_batch <- function(input_dir, 
                               output_dir,
                               slice_height = 256L,
                               slice_width = 256L,
                               overlap_height_ratio = 0.2,
                               overlap_width_ratio = 0.2,
                               out_ext = ".jpg",  # Added this parameter
                               image_extensions = c("jpg", "jpeg", "png", "tif", "tiff")) {
  
  # Expand paths (handles ~ properly)
  input_dir <- path_expand(input_dir)
  output_dir <- path_expand(output_dir)
  
  # Create output directory if it doesn't exist
  dir_create(output_dir, recurse = TRUE)
  
  # Get all image files
  image_files <- dir_ls(input_dir, 
                        regexp = paste0("\\.(", paste(image_extensions, collapse = "|"), ")$"),
                        recurse = FALSE)
  
  if (length(image_files) == 0) {
    stop("No image files found in ", input_dir)
  }
  
  cat("Found", length(image_files), "images to process\n\n")
  
  # Create progress bar
  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    format = "  [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta: :eta",
    total = length(image_files),
    clear = FALSE,
    width = 80
  )
  
  # Process each image
  results <- tibble(
    image_path = image_files,
    filename = path_file(image_path),
    filename_no_ext = path_ext_remove(filename),
    num_slices = NA_integer_,
    success = FALSE
  )
  
  for (i in seq_along(image_files)) {
    pb$tick()
    
    tryCatch({
      result <- sahi$slice_image(
        image = as.character(results$image_path[i]),
        output_file_name = as.character(results$filename_no_ext[i]),
        output_dir = as.character(output_dir),
        slice_height = as.integer(slice_height),
        slice_width = as.integer(slice_width),
        overlap_height_ratio = as.numeric(overlap_height_ratio),
        overlap_width_ratio = as.numeric(overlap_width_ratio),
        out_ext = out_ext  # Pass the extension parameter
      )
      
      results$num_slices[i] <- length(result$images)
      results$success[i] <- TRUE
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Failed to process ", results$filename[i], ": ", e$message, call. = FALSE)
      results$success[i] <<- FALSE
    })
  }
  
  # Summary
  cat("\n\nCompleted!\n")
  cat("  Successfully processed:", sum(results$success), "images\n")
  cat("  Failed:", sum(!results$success), "images\n")
  cat("  Total slices created:", sum(results$num_slices, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("  Output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  
  return(results)
}

# Example usage - saves as JPG by default:
# results <- slice_images_batch(
#   input_dir = "~/dropbox/pretrain",
#   output_dir = "~/dropbox/sliced_images"
# )

# Or specify PNG:
# results <- slice_images_batch(
#   input_dir = "~/dropbox/pretrain",
#   output_dir = "~/dropbox/sliced_images",
#   out_ext = ".png"
# )
  # Create progress b
# Example usage:
slice_images_batch(
  input_dir = '~/dropbox/pretrain/',
  output_dir = "~/dropbox/pretrain_slices/",
  slice_height = 1024,
  slice_width = 1024,
  overlap_height_ratio = 0.2,
  overlap_width_ratio = 0.2
)
```

```{r}
library(reticulate)
library(fs)

# Import SAHI
sahi <- import("sahi.slicing")

# Test with a single image first
test_image <- "~/dropbox/pretrain/105-27_xp_000018.jpg"  # <- Update this
test_output_dir <- "test_slices"       # <- Update this

# Create output directory
dir_create(test_output_dir)

# Try slicing one image
cat("Attempting to slice image...\n")
result <- sahi$slice_image(
  image = test_image,
  output_file_name = "test",
  output_dir = test_output_dir,
  slice_height = 256L,
  slice_width = 256L,
  overlap_height_ratio = 0.2,
  overlap_width_ratio = 0.2
)

# Check the result
cat("\nResult object type:", class(result), "\n")
cat("Result attributes:", paste(names(result), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Check if images were created
cat("\nNumber of slices in result$images:", length(result$images), "\n")

# Check what files are in the output directory
output_files <- dir_ls(test_output_dir)
cat("\nFiles in output directory:", length(output_files), "\n")
if (length(output_files) > 0) {
  print(output_files)
} else {
  cat("No files created!\n")
}

# Check if image_dir attribute exists
if ("image_dir" %in% names(result)) {
  cat("\nresult$image_dir:", result$image_dir, "\n")
}
```
